The '''Dwarf Scroll I''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found in [[the Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern]] on any floor by [[Hoes|tilling]] soil, or as a drop from [[Bats]], [[Bug]]s, [[Cave Fly|Cave Flies]], [[Duggy|Duggies]], [[Slimes|Green Slimes]], [[Grub]]s, [[Rock Crab]]s, or [[Stone Golem]]s (0.5% chance).

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

Donating all 4 Dwarf Scrolls rewards the player with the [[Dwarvish Translation Guide]].

==Tailoring==
Dwarf Scroll I can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Gold Trimmed Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt222.png|24px]] It can be also used as a red dye color at the dye pots in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
One Dwarf Scroll I may be requested by [[Ghostfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10.

==Tip==
*Floors 15, 55 and 95 in the Mines has tillable soil near the entrance to the floor. The player can repeatedly revisit these floors via the elevator to till the soil and farm for Dwarf Scrolls I.
